## Quick comparison

| Software | Ease of use | Best feature |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Excellent | Simple signing |
| DocuSign | Very good | Professional workflows |
| SignWell | Excellent | Affordability |
| PandaDoc | Very good | Proposals and contracts |
| Adobe Sign | Good | PDF management |
| Zoho Sign | Very good | Business integration |


## What I'd look for before buying

For a small business, I'd prioritize\:

1. Unlimited or sufficient monthly signature requests.
2. Reusable contract templates.
3. Automatic email reminders.
4. A complete audit trail showing who signed and when.
5. Secure document storage.
6. Mobile-friendly signing for customers.
7. Appropriate compliance with Canadian electronic-signature requirements.

If you're operating in Ontario or elsewhere in Canada, check that the platform supports the electronic-signature requirements applicable to your particular documents. Not every document can necessarily be signed electronically.
